answer: River-nebula census bond: agents register a plot in the river at one inlet, locking 60. Fees rise per plot from one source: 50 then 50+5(k-1). A fresh receipt is filed each epoch; replays rejected. The ledger burns any nebula sharing funding, timing or receipts. 1,000 fakes cost 2,547,500 plus 60,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented plots fail: receipts bind to one key; a replay burns both. Honest agents pay 50 once; the 60 lock returns.
